scope: Scratch substantive language review only. No production, checkpoint, shared-test, source-registry, reference, review-status or expression writes. input.hash_basis: Raw file bytes; entry hashes are SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(entry) preserving parsed key order.

selection.method: Next ten language-pending entries after the accepted first ten in Foundation Module02 file order.

global_limits: All ten projected entries retain pending overall/language review, original domain status, pending morphology and media. There is no change in reviewed counts or release readiness.

Canonical identities, accepted forms, regions, practice modes, historical references, editorial notes and all course/expression bytes remain exact preimages. Separate proposed editorial notes do not modify those fields.

Dictionary levels are literal selected-sense findings, not lesson certification. Oxford rendered labels, public HTML metadata, and unrelated footer labels remain distinct. Collins B1+ is preserved literally and is not rounded into a CEFR equivalence.
Source consultations include only original authored summaries and minimal identifiers/metadata; no dictionary pages, examples, media or exercises are imported.
No new whole-expression acceptance, sense binding, subject-matter approval or human sign-off is claimed.
